ui.procedures.badge.withheld: Left out of the agents' list
ui.procedures.empty: No agent has kept a procedure yet.
ui.procedures.filter.label: Filter the procedures
ui.procedures.lead: What the agents of this workspace worked out about recurring tasks, kept so the next agent reads it first and explores only what changed. You can read each one, see who wrote it and what it saved.
ui.procedures.leadWeb: Here you can read them. Editing, marking as reviewed and deleting are done on the computer.
ui.procedures.list.label: Procedures
ui.procedures.loadError: The procedures could not be read.
ui.procedures.off: Procedures are off in this workspace (Settings › Runner): agents neither read nor write them. What is kept stays here to read.
ui.procedures.offDesktop: Procedures are off in this workspace (Settings › Runner): agents neither read nor write them. What is kept stays here for you to read, edit or delete.
ui.procedures.panel.invalid: This file is not a readable procedure.
ui.procedures.panel.keyedByApp: The site was taken from the pages the agent's browser visited.
ui.procedures.panel.missing: This procedure is gone: it was deleted or never existed.
ui.procedures.panel.newer: This procedure was written by a newer app and is left alone.
ui.procedures.panel.old: Not verified for more than 90 days.
ui.procedures.panel.stateFailing: An agent reported step {step} as not working on {date}. Agents follow only the parts that still hold until one replaces it.
ui.procedures.panel.stateOk: Last used on {date} with no failure reported. That is all the app can tell: nobody tested the steps.
ui.procedures.panel.stateUnverified: Not confirmed by a later use yet.
ui.procedures.panel.stepsAgent: The steps were written by the agent.
ui.procedures.panel.stepsEdited: The steps are the app's recording, with some reworded.
ui.procedures.panel.stepsRecording: The steps are the app's recording of what the screen did.
ui.procedures.panel.unreviewed: You have not reviewed this revision. Agents read it as it is, marked as not reviewed.
ui.procedures.panel.usage.approximate: Approximate: the call that found it and the ones that used it did other work too, so this compares and does not measure.
ui.procedures.panel.usage.noBaseline: What finding it cost is not known: the call that created it has not finished.
ui.procedures.panel.usage.noSaving: A use costs as much as finding it did, or more: no saving to show.
ui.procedures.panel.usage.notEnough: Not enough uses to compare: {counted} counted, at least {needed} are needed.
ui.procedures.panel.usage.saved: About {tokens} tokens saved: what finding it cost, minus the average use, times the uses.
ui.procedures.panel.usage.savedCost: About {tokens} tokens saved, and about {cost} reported by the provider.
ui.procedures.panel.usage.savedCostEstim: About {tokens} tokens saved, and about {cost} estimated.
ui.procedures.panel.withheld: It failed twice since it was last saved, so the agents' list leaves it out. Correct it or delete it.
ui.procedures.skipped: {count} files in the procedures folder were not read: written by a newer app, or not a procedure.
ui.procedures.summary.label: The workspace's procedures in numbers
ui.procedures.summary.noSaving: No saving to show yet: a procedure needs at least 3 uses that cost less than finding it did.
ui.procedures.summary.saved: About {tokens} tokens saved in {procedures} procedures with enough uses. Approximate: see each procedure.
ui.procedures.summary.savedCost: About {tokens} tokens saved in {procedures} procedures with enough uses, and about {cost} reported by the provider. Approximate: see each procedure.
ui.procedures.summary.savedCostEstimated: About {tokens} tokens saved in {procedures} procedures with enough uses, and about {cost} estimated. Approximate: see each procedure.
ui.procedures.surface.called: a conversation with an agent another one called
ui.procedures.title: Learned procedures
